rv.q: What would Gray have thought if he’d lived to see Warbucks singing the New Deal’s praises?
You’ll leave this uplifting show smiling and humming.
Annie proves to be a great winter and holiday outing.
This musical comedy is, after all, what Christmas spirit is all about.
And while the show certainly offers a whitewashed kind of nostalgia, there are worse things to put onstage right now than a call for hope and resilience in tough days.
This company always does a great job but this production is perfection.
This is a wonderful holiday show for the family and as always Music Theater Works finds the right talent for their productions.

Music Theater Works’ production of Annie is an easy recommendation for families and children, offering a warm and hopeful theatrical experience well suited for the holiday season and an inviting escape from the chilly Illinois winter.

cn.t: Music Theater Works delivers a spirited, warm-hearted production of the beloved musical that proves irresistibly optimistic for families. Critics praise the charming leads and ensemble work in this holiday-appropriate crowd-pleaser.
